positional_first2.scope: Descriptive matched cases only; queries within each document group are correlated.

source_annotation_numeric_coverage.scope: Mechanical exposure only: coverage is not sufficiency. NotMentioned has no support annotations. Numeric occurrences are counted per query, repeating each document3times; no independent-fact count.

historical_reference_scope: Raw full-threeway and discarded-neutral readouts are predeclared offline same-logit references bound in the accepted plan. They are not accepted heads, tuned thresholds, candidate selection or confirmation gates; no rescue/promotion based on which wins. Main trained readout preserves all3classes.
pilot_limits: Only this bounded project-level split, with24 train and8 DEV document groups; not an official leaderboard evaluation.
Training labels describe full agreements while each arm reads selected excerpts; coverage does not establish sufficiency.
Model pretraining/public-data contamination unknown; no causal gain claim comparing different historical epochs.
No unused DEV source/labels opened after fit failure and no unused confirmation labels opened.

one_next_direction.status: Unimplemented/unmeasured; no automatic new run or tuning
one_next_direction.hypothesis: Use one predeclared evidence-sufficiency/deontic-scope training objective with document-group holdout, preserving all3classes and matched selectors; choose its source rule before any new held-out labels.
one_next_direction.separation: No fitting or threshold change on this consumed DEV or unused confirmation; preserve the frozen study and select no alternative from these outcomes.
